units.source_text: 源氏公子因有女同车，帘子也不卷起，便有许多人心怀妒恨。

en.t: Because Prince Genji had a woman riding with him in the same carriage and did not even raise the blinds, many people felt jealous and resentful.

units.source_text: 他们想：“前天祓禊时，他的态度很威严，今天却是随意游览。

en.t: They thought, "At the purification ceremony the other day, his manner was very dignified, but today he is merely out sightseeing at leisure.

units.source_text: 和他同车的人到底是谁？

en.t: Who on earth is the person riding with him in the same carriage?
She must surely be no ordinary person."
Everyone speculated this way and that.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得刚才和不相称的人酬酢唱和，很犯不着。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that exchanging courtesies and poems just now with someone so unsuitable had hardly been worth the trouble.

units.source_text: 但倘送诗给不像内侍那样厚颜无耻的人，

en.t: But if he sent poems to women who were not shameless like the Naishi,

units.source_text: 又恐她们顾虑到他有女同车，

en.t: he feared that they would be troubled by the fact that he had a woman riding with him,

units.source_text: 连寥寥数字的回音也不肯放心地送给他吧。

en.t: and would not feel at ease sending him even a reply of just a few words.
For now, let this matter be set aside.
